hooks.name: Guard Destructive Commands
hooks.description: Pede confirmacao antes de comandos destrutivos (terraform apply/destroy, kubectl delete, rm -rf, git force/reset)

action.command: payload=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // .command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'terraform +(apply|destroy)|kubectl.*delete|rm +-rf|git +push +--force|git +reset +--hard|git +clean +-[a-z]*f'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Comando destrutivo detectado. Confirme antes de executar."}}'; fi; exit 0
